name: com.markhavenbrands/markhaven
title: Markhaven
description: Check brand names against U.S. trademark filings and domains. Facts only. Free consultation.

tools.name: check_names
tools.description: Check one to six brand or business name ideas at once against live U.S. federal trademark filings, plus whether the .com and .co are registered. Use when the user is brainstorming, choosing or comparing names for a brand, shop, product or business. Returns facts only (exact, close and similar filings, closest marks, domains), never a legal opinion.

names.description: The name ideas, one per item, e.g. ["Snoutlove", "Wagwell"].

tools.name: suggest_names
tools.description: Suggest up to 10 brand name ideas for what the user sells, each already checked against live U.S. federal trademark filings (for similar products and overall) plus the .com and .co. Use when the user wants name ideas and does not have a list yet. Returns facts only (what is on file), never a legal opinion; ideas are starting points, not a clearance.

about.description: What the brand sells or does, in a few words, e.g. "small-batch soy candles".

category.description: Product category, if clear. Guessed from "about" when left out.

vibe.description: Up to three styles for the names.

include.description: A word the user wants in the name, if any.

tools.name: name_details
tools.description: Full facts for one brand name: exact, close and similar U.S. trademark filings with owners, filing years and goods, the .com and .co, and a shareable report link on markhavenbrands.com. Use when the user is seriously considering a name or asks whether a specific name is taken or trademarked.

name.description: The brand name to look at.

tools.name: start_name_watch
tools.description: Start free Name Watch for a brand name: for about 3 months Markhaven checks new U.S. trademark filings and emails the user only if something close is filed. Email only, no card, nothing renews. Only call this after the user asks for it and gives their email address.

email.description: The email address the user gave for Name Watch notes.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Get the link to book a 30-minute consultation with Markhaven on Google Meet (no charge). An independent licensed attorney reviews the name before the call; it covers which trademark classes to file in, whether similar names matter, what filing involves, and every option, including filing yourself. Use when the user wants help protecting, filing or choosing a name.

name.description: The brand name they want to talk about, if known.
